pvp.title: Free-Flight PvP
pvp.description: Free flight in a 3D arena. Guest rooms are first to five eliminations.
pvp.invite: Invite a pilot with this code
pvp.copyError: Copy failed. Select the room code and copy it manually.
pvp.instructions: Create a room or enter its 6-character code. The PvP host must be configured first.
pvp.unavailable: PvP host is not configured yet. Deploy the server and add its public WSS URL to the game, then retry.
pvp.invalidConfig: The PvP host configuration is invalid or does not match this game build.
pvp.network: Could not load PvP host settings. Check your connection and retry.
pvp.connecting: Connecting to the PvP host. A free service may need a moment to wake.
pvp.disconnected: Unable to reach the PvP host. Retry the connection or leave the room.
pvp.error.room_not_found: Room not found or expired. Check the code or create a room.
pvp.error.room_full: That room already has two pilots.
pvp.error.origin_not_allowed: The PvP host rejected this game origin. Check the Render ALLOWED_ORIGINS setting.
pvp.error.incompatible_build: The PvP client and server builds do not match. Deploy matching versions.
pvp.error.invalid_hello: The host rejected the session. Reload the game and try again.
pvp.error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait briefly, then retry.
pvp.error.server_busy: The PvP host is full. Try again later.
pvp.error.resume_expired: This room session expired. Leave the room, then create or join again.
pvp.error.handshake_timeout: The host did not receive a valid session in time. Retry the connection.
pvp.error.invalid_resume: The reconnect token is invalid. Leave the room and join again.
pvp.error.invalid_input: The host rejected an input packet. Reload and retry.
pvp.error.invalid_message: The host rejected a network message. Reload and retry.
pvp.error.unknown: The PvP host rejected the connection.
pvp.waiting: Room open. Share the code and wait for another pilot.
